scope: The standing Holy Name Cathedral sandstone perimeter walls and stone balustrades on Ann Street and the Gotha Street return in Fortitude Valley.

originalReview.notes: The cleared original shows square-cut pale masonry, recessed round-headed arches, heavy molded top courses and small repeated turned balusters between wide rectangular piers. Early steps and the crowd establish scale; present wall alignment and limits follow the state record.

quallaSearch.notes: The original foundation stone photograph was reviewed first in Qualla. The specific archival JPEG has a CC0 release from QUT and matches the native Commons SHA-1. Later images with attribution licenses and separate documents without an individual CC0 release were excluded.
